name: Aishwarya
greetingText: I really like your name btw!
wishText:
Tum sochogi kyon itna Main tumse pyaar karoon
  Tum samjhogi deewana Main bhi iqraar karoon
  Dewaanon ki yeh baatein Deewane jaante hain
  Jalne mei kya mazaa hai Parwane jaante hain
  Tum yunhi jalate rehna Aa aakar khwabon mein
  Pal pal dil ke paas tum rehti ho
